pages.text: This diary is still almost blank - only a hasty line remains on the flyleaf:$(br)$(2)"At the end of Chi Energy lies the beginning of Life."$(br2)The moment you aggregate your first Life Energy, every page will be filled with new discoveries.$(br2)$(bold)Current contents:$(li)Life Energy Purifier$(li)Life Essence Solid

This book shares its origin with the Chishi Research Diary, covering the Life Energy chapter after the Chapter of Chishi:$(li)Life Aggregation Converter$(li)Life Conversion Architecture$(li)Life Energy Pipe$(li)Life Energy Cell$(li)Life Energy Purifier$(br2)Each step of research will reveal a new section - just like the Chishi path.
